content.headline: Check the Data First, Then Choose the AI
content.body: Treat every free AI tool like an open phone line that anyone can hear. Before you paste anything, ask: would I be fine if this exact text appeared on a public website tomorrow?
bullets: Never upload to free AI: Aadhaar or citizen ID numbers, FIR or evidence, Cabinet drafts, medical records, tender evaluation sheets, unpublished budget numbers, or anything that identifies a citizen
Level 1, Public → normal AI tools are fine
Level 2, Internal → use enterprise AI with a no-training agreement
Level 3, Confidential → use only a local, on-site AI
Level 4, Classified → no internet-connected AI at all
